tools.name: find_promo_codes
tools.description: Live promo codes for one online store, best offer first. Accepts the store's name, its website (“store.com”) or any URL on it. Each code comes with what it gives, its conditions, how many shoppers said it worked and when it last worked. When no store matches, it says so and suggests close matches in

tools.name: search_stores
tools.description: Stores CouponLlama covers that match a name or a category, with how many live codes each has and its best offer. Use it to browse (“which pet stores have codes?”) or when the user isn't sure of a store's exact name.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Every store category, with its slug, what it covers and how many stores in it have a live code.

tools.name: latest_promo_codes
tools.description: The newest live codes across every store, optionally within one category. Good for “any new deals on…” questions.

tools.name: report_code_result
tools.description: Tell CouponLlama whether a code worked at checkout. The report joins the shopper vote tally, so the next person (or agent) knows which codes to trust. Call it once per code you tried.
